c8180a8e6e0ede48.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة تحديد لنقل الطرود عن كاتب استعلامات مركز خدمة عملاء للانضمام إلى فريقها في سيهات، المنطقة الشرقية. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تقديم الدعم الأساسي للعملاء من خلال الإجابة على استفساراتهم ومعالجة طلباتهم باستخدام قنوات الاتصال المختلفة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية الرد على استفسارات العملاء الأساسية وتقديم المشورة والمعلومات حول منتجات الشركة وخدماتها وسياساتها. معالجة طلبات العملاء الأساسية، مثل إرسال الرسائل أو النماذج أو الوثائق الأخرى، بالإضافة إلى معالجة المعاملات المالية. حل شكاوى العملاء الأولية وإحالة المشكلات الأكثر تعقيدًا إلى الموظفين المختصين أو مسؤولي الشكاوى. تسجيل جميع الاستعلامات والشكاوى الواردة وتوثيق الحلول المتخذة. الالتزام التام بالإجراءات التشغيلية والسياسات المنظمة لمركز خدمة العملاء. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال خدمة العملاء أو دور مشابه. القدرة على استخدام وسائل الاتصال الهاتفية والإلكترونية بفعالية. مهارات تواصل ممتازة وقدرة على التعامل مع العملاء بمهنية. بيئة العمل يعمل كاتب الاستعلامات ضمن مركز خدمة العملاء في شركة تحديد لنقل الطرود في سيهات، المنطقة الشرقية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التفاعل المباشر مع العملاء لضمان تقديم خدمة عالية الجودة. التقديم لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب لهذه الوظيفة. ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم.

c8d2dc3654e6d450.description: نبحث في محلنا عن موظفات شغوفات ولديهن الرغبة في التطور، للانضمام إلى فريقنا المتميز في قسم النسخ والتصوير، وفق الشروط والمؤهلات التالية: المهام: 1- القيام بعمليات الطباعة، تصوير 2- مراجعة جودة المطبوعات والتأكد من مطابقتها لطلب العميل قبل تسليمها 3-تنظيم وترتيب قسم التصوير وخدمة العملاء بدون تاخير 4- تقديم الدعم والمشورة للعملاء حول أفضل خيارات الطباعة والتنفيذ المناسبة لاحتياجاتهم 5- العمل بروح الفريق وانجاز المهام المسنده اليها 6- التعامل مع برامج مايكروسوفت اوفيس 7- الاحترافيه والامانه بالتعامل بيئة العمل مختلطه للسعوديات او بنات مواطنه فتره العمل مسائية من 4 الى ** الاجازة يوم بالاسبوع

c83c59ded9061f07.description: About the Role HUDSON is seeking a Cost Control Engineer to join their team in Saudi Arabia. This full-time position requires strong experience in the Oil & Gas industry, with a preference for candidates who have worked on EPC and/or Shutdown & Turnaround (SD/TA) projects. The role offers a basic salary ranging from 5000 to 7000. Key Responsibilities Applying strong cost control principles within the Oil & Gas, Petrochemical, or Refinery industries. Contributing to projects, with a preference for those involving Shutdown & Turnaround activities. Utilizing Primavera P6 for project control and cost management tasks. Preparing and presenting reports with clear and effective English communication skills. Qualifications and Experience A Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or a relevant technical qualification. 5-10 years of experience, with a strong background in the Oil & Gas, Petrochemical, or Refinery industry. Demonstrated hands-on experience with Primavera P6. Proficiency in English communication and reporting. Prior experience in Saudi Arabia or the GCC region is preferred. Experience in Shutdown & Turnaround projects is highly preferred. Additional certification in Cost Control, Project Controls, or Quantity Surveying is an advantage. Work Location This position is based in Saudi Arabia, with potential work locations including Dammam, Al Khobar, Dhahran, Al Jubail, Al-Ahsa, Al Qatif, Ras Tannurah, Al Khafji, Buqayq, and Hafar Al Batin. Application Requirements Candidates must possess relevant experience that directly aligns with the requirements of this Cost Control Engineer position.

c8455dc8ca5efa70.description: About the Role TikTok is seeking an Account Manager (Growth) for its Global Business Solutions (GBS) team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is focused on driving revenue growth and client success within the MENA region by managing a portfolio of advertisers. The position requires 5-10 years of experience and is nationalized, available only to Saudi national citizens or individuals qualifying for equivalent Saudization status. Role Context and Objectives The Global Business Solutions (GBS) team at TikTok is responsible for regional sales and advertising, promoting advertising solutions, client onboarding, and campaign execution. This role specifically supports the Growth team, which assists businesses and brands in connecting with their audiences on TikTok. The Account Manager will manage and expand a diverse portfolio of advertisers, focusing on increasing revenue, ensuring client success, and promoting product adoption. This involves building client relationships, identifying investment scaling opportunities, and providing strategic guidance to help clients achieve their business goals on the TikTok platform. Key Responsibilities Manage and expand a portfolio of SMB advertisers across the Middle East, focusing on revenue growth and long-term client success. Cultivate trusted relationships with advertisers and identify opportunities to increase their investment and scale their business on TikTok. Develop account strategies based on client objectives, performance data, seasonality, and market opportunities. Drive the adoption of TikTok's advertising products, measurement solutions, and best practices among clients. Identify, reactivate, and develop high-potential advertisers within the assigned portfolio. Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Product, Finance, Marketing, and Operations to resolve client challenges and facilitate growth. Maintain strong sales discipline in pipeline management, forecasting, client engagement, and opportunity planning. Share market and client insights to contribute to TikTok's SMB strategy across the region. Required Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of relevant professional experience. Strong sales and account management capabilities. Expertise in digital advertising. Demonstrated analytical thinking skills. Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative work environment. Fluency in Arabic is required for this role. Work Environment and Location This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role operates within a dynamic and collaborative environment, requiring adaptability to constant shifts in client needs, market trends, and performance expectations across different markets. Additional Information This role is nationalized in accordance with the requirements of the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development and is exclusively available to Saudi national citizens or individuals who qualify for equivalent status for Saudization purposes.

c8921b5f9da40cdb.description: HanmiGlobal Saudi is seeking a competent Surveyor to join our team and contribute to the accurate measurement and mapping of construction sites. The Surveyor will support project teams by collecting and analyzing data to ensure precision in construction planning and execution. Key Responsibilities Conduct field surveys to collect accurate data concerning land, structures, and construction sites. Utilize surveying equipment and software to measure distances, elevations, and angles. Prepare and maintain detailed records, sketches, and reports of survey findings. Collaborate with engineers, quantity surveyors, and project managers to provide necessary survey data. Ensure compliance with safety standards and project specifications during fieldwork. Assist in setting out construction works according to design plans and specifications. Maintain and calibrate surveying instruments as needed. Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Surveying, Civil Engineering, or a related field. Minimum 7 years of experience in surveying, preferably within the construction industry. Proficient in using modern surveying instruments and software (e.g., Total Station, AutoCAD, GPS). Good understanding of surveying principles, techniques, and safety standards. Strong attention to detail and excellent analytical skills. Good communication and teamwork abilities. Experience working on projects in Saudi Arabia or similar environments is advantageous.

c81af80b630c8e09.job_title: Hostess InterContinental The Red Sea Resort
c81af80b630c8e09.description: About the Role IHG Hotels & Resorts is seeking a Hostess for the InterContinental The Red Sea Resort. This full-time position is based in Umluj, Tabuk, Saudi Arabia. The Hostess is responsible for creating a welcoming first impression for guests by providing professional, courteous, and personalized service, ensuring every guest experience reflects the luxury service standards of InterContinental Hotels & Resorts and IHG. Key Responsibilities Warmly and professionally welcome and greet all guests upon arrival, using the restaurant and guest names when possible. Ensure the restaurant entrance, hostess station, tables, and surrounding areas are clean, organized, and prepared before opening. Verify guest reservations and booking details in the reservation system or book. Manage restaurant reservations, including telephone bookings, walk-ins, special requests, and guest dining preferences. Escort guests to their assigned or preferred tables and present menus according to service standards. Coordinate guest seating arrangements and table allocation with the restaurant service team to ensure smooth operations. Provide accurate waiting times and manage guest flow during busy periods. Maintain detailed knowledge of the restaurant menu, beverages, daily specials, promotions, and hotel facilities. Respond promptly and courteously to guest inquiries, requests, and complaints, ensuring appropriate follow-up. Recognize VIP guests, repeat guests, and special occasions to provide personalized service. Coordinate with the Restaurant Manager, service team, and Culinary team to communicate guest preferences and dietary requirements. Maintain the cleanliness and proper presentation of menus, beverage lists, and the hostess station. Assist with food and beverage service when required to support restaurant operations. Maintain accurate guest reservation records and update guest information in the designated system. Promote restaurant offerings and special promotions to enhance the guest experience. Operational Standards and Compliance Maintain professional grooming, personal hygiene, and uniform standards in accordance with IHG policies. Attend departmental briefings, meetings, and training sessions as required. Follow all hotel policies, procedures, brand standards, and applicable food safety and hygiene requirements. Demonstrate awareness of occupational health and safety procedures, fire and emergency protocols, and security requirements. Perform any other reasonable duties assigned by the Restaurant Manager or Food & Beverage Management. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 year of experience in a similar role. Ability to provide professional, courteous, and personalized service. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Work Environment This role operates within the luxury hospitality environment of the InterContinental The Red Sea Resort, located in Umluj, Tabuk, Saudi Arabia. The position is full-time and requires adherence to high service standards.

c8a31f723d31767f.description: About the Role Saudi Pan Kingdom Company - SAPAC is seeking a Planning Manager Roads & Infrastructure to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is central to ensuring efficient project management and the successful execution of roads and infrastructure projects. The Planning Manager will be responsible for developing comprehensive project plans, coordinating resources, and overseeing the scheduling and progress of construction activities. Role Overview The Planning Manager plays a pivotal role in the project lifecycle, from initial planning to completion. This position requires a strong understanding of construction processes, excellent organizational skills, and the ability to communicate effectively with various stakeholders. The ideal candidate will ensure that projects adhere to timelines and financial targets through meticulous planning and monitoring. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement detailed project plans, including schedules, resource allocation, and budgeting, to ensure timely completion of construction projects. Collaborate with project managers, engineers, architects, and other stakeholders to gather project requirements and develop a clear understanding of project objectives. Conduct regular project meetings to review progress, identify potential issues, and develop action plans to mitigate risks and ensure project milestones are achieved. Monitor and analyze project schedules and budgets, identifying deviations and implementing corrective measures as necessary to maintain project timelines and financial targets. Coordinate with procurement teams to ensure timely delivery of materials and equipment required for construction activities, optimizing resource utilization and minimizing project delays. Utilize project management software and tools to track project progress, update schedules, and generate reports for management and stakeholders. Provide leadership and guidance to the planning team, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in planning and project management, specifically within roads and infrastructure projects. Strong understanding of construction processes and project lifecycle management. Proficiency in project management software and tools. Required Skills Excellent organizational and time management skills. Effective communication and interpersonal abilities for stakeholder engagement. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities. Leadership skills to guide and develop a planning team. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, offering an opportunity to contribute to significant infrastructure development projects within a professional and collaborative environment.

c813b63ca0c01b22.description: About the Role Marriott International is seeking a Chef-Specialty Restaurant to join our team in Makkah. This full-time role is responsible for the quality, consistency, and production of the specialty restaurant kitchen. The Chef will lead staff, manage all food-related functions, and coordinate menus, purchasing, staffing, and food preparation for the property's specialty restaurant. The ideal candidate will have 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Develop, design, and create new applications, ideas, and products, including artistic contributions for the specialty restaurant. Supervise specialty restaurant kitchen shift operations, ensuring compliance with all Food & Beverage policies, standards, and procedures. Maintain food preparation, handling, and correct storage standards. Plan and manage food quantities and plating requirements, communicating production needs to key personnel. Assist in developing daily and seasonal menu items. Prepare and cook various food types, checking the quality of raw and cooked products to ensure standards are met. Determine food presentation and create decorative food displays. Team Leadership and Management Supervise and coordinate activities of cooks and workers engaged in food preparation. Lead shift teams while personally preparing food items and executing requests. Manage all day-to-day operations of specialty restaurant kitchen employees, understanding positions to perform duties in their absence. Encourage mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members. Ensure and maintain the productivity level of employees, ensuring they are cross-trained and understand expectations. Establish and maintain open, collaborative relationships with employees. Operational Goals and Standards Set and support the achievement of kitchen goals, including performance, budget, and team goals. Develop specific guidance and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish daily kitchen operations. Understand the impact of kitchen operations on overall property financial goals and manage to achieve or exceed budgeted goals. Effectively investigate, report, and follow up on employee accidents, implementing company safety standards. Ensure sanitation and food standards are achieved, complying with all applicable laws and regulations. Guest Service and Human Resources Manage day-to-day operations to ensure quality and standards meet customer expectations. Improve service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance and feedback. Set a positive example for guest relations and emphasize guest satisfaction in departmental meetings. Handle guest problems and complaints, interacting with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels. Identify developmental needs of others, coaching and mentoring to improve knowledge or skills. Participate in training specialty restaurant staff on menu items, ingredients, and preparation methods. Manage employee progressive discipline procedures and participate in performance appraisals. Assist in the interviewing and hiring of team members with appropriate skills. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in a culinary role, preferably within a specialty restaurant setting. Demonstrated culinary talents and ability to lead a kitchen team. Strong interpersonal and communication skills. Ability to manage operating budgets and ensure financial goals are met. Knowledge of sanitation and food safety standards. Additional Responsibilities Provide information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates through various communication channels. Analyze information and evaluate results to choose the best solutions and solve problems. Attend and participate in all pertinent meetings.

c81d266c13f7e294.description: About the Role Multilink Management Consultants is seeking an Estimation Engineer to join their team in Dammam, Eastern Province. This full-time position requires a professional with a background in Electrical & Instrumentation Engineering and significant experience in estimation processes. Role Overview The Estimation Engineer will be responsible for the comprehensive analysis of tender documents, technical specifications, and engineering drawings to accurately determine project costs and prepare detailed bid packages. This role is central to the company's tendering process, ensuring competitive and precise proposals. Key Responsibilities Analyze Invitations to Tender (ITTs), scope of work documents, and technical specifications to understand project requirements. Extract material quantities (Material Take-Offs and Bill of Quantities) from engineering drawings, single-line diagrams, and P&IDs. Perform detailed cost calculations for materials, labor, and other project components. Evaluate vendor quotes to ensure cost-effectiveness and compliance with project specifications. Compile comprehensive techno-commercial bid packages for submission to clients or main contractors. Qualifications and Experience A degree in Electrical & Instrumentation Engineering is required. Candidates should possess 5 to 10 years of experience in an estimation engineering role. Work Setting This is a full-time position based in Dammam, within the Eastern Province. The salary for this role will be discussed during the interview process. Application Process Interested candidates who meet the specified qualifications are encouraged to apply.

c80fa9602b7a6c00.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اتحاد الخليج للاغذية عن مصمم جرافيك للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور على تطوير الأفكار والمفاهيم الإبداعية لتوصيل الرسائل المطلوبة عبر وسائل الجرافيك المختلفة. سيقوم المصمم بوضع المخططات العامة وتصميم الإنتاج للإعلانات والمجلات وتقارير الشركات وغيرها من وسائل الإعلام المنشورة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية التنسيق مع مالكي التصميم (عملاء داخليون أو خارجيون) لفهم الرسالة المراد نقلها، وتحديد المتطلبات، والاتفاق على المنتج النهائي. تطوير مفاهيم التصميم العامة لتلبية احتياجات العميل، وصياغة أسلوب يتناسب مع الصورة والوضع المطلوبين. تقديم المشورة الفنية المتعلقة بمفاهيم التصميم العامة، وتقديم الإرشادات بشأن المتطلبات الأسلوبية مثل الألوان والصور ونمط النص والمخطط، لضمان توصيل الرسالة بفعالية. تسليم المنتج النهائي للعميل وجمع الملاحظات وإدراجها في التصميم عند الحاجة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال تصميم الجرافيك. القدرة على تطوير أفكار إبداعية ومفاهيم تصميمية. فهم جيد لمبادئ التصميم الجرافيكي وتطبيقاته في مختلف وسائل الإعلام. نوع العمل والموقع هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. يتطلب الدور التواجد في مقر الشركة للعمل ضمن الفريق. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى شركة اتحاد الخليج للاغذية كـ مصمم جرافيك، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم.

c87d1b59e1f8674a.description: About the Role Plaza Premium Group is seeking a Guest Services Associate to provide professional guest services in airport lounges across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is based in Arar, Northern Frontier, and involves ensuring a positive guest experience through courteous, efficient, and responsive service. The role supports lounge operations by accurately handling guest records, cash transactions, and operational checks. Key Responsibilities Manage guest check-in procedures and ensure compliance with lounge admission guidelines. Greet, receive, and bid farewell to guests at lounge entrances and reception areas. Assist guests with internet access, baggage arrangements, shower access, and nap room bookings. Conduct regular checks of all lounge areas and report maintenance or cleaning requirements. Promote lounge services and facilities while professionally handling guest requests and complaints. Manage lost and found items and maintain proper documentation. Handle confidential guest information with a high level of integrity and discretion. Answer incoming telephone calls and take appropriate immediate actions when required. Maintain accurate records of cash flows, receipts, and related documentation. Support the implementation and continuous improvement of quality management systems. Perform any other duties assigned by the Supervisor in line with operational requirements. Qualifications and Requirements High school certificate or equivalent; a diploma or Bachelor’s degree is an advantage. Previous experience (0-1 year) in hospitality, customer service, or airport operations is an advantage. Presentable, customer-focused, and professional with strong interpersonal and communication skills. Ability to work independently and under pressure in a fast-paced environment. Basic cash handling skills and attention to detail. Willingness to work shift duties as required. Work Environment This role operates within an airport lounge setting in Arar, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, requiring adaptability to a dynamic environment and adherence to operational schedules, including shift duties.

c89ccd7b35b90828.description: About the Role LUMA Energy is seeking a CX Advisor Regional to join their team in Neom, Tabuk, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position for an individual with 1-3 years of experience. The CX Advisor serves as the primary point of contact for customers, managing a variety of inquiries to ensure accurate information delivery and a positive customer experience. Key Responsibilities Provide assistance to internal and external customers by directing, gathering, and delivering information for issue resolution, addressing concerns and complaints related to billing, claims, or retailer inquiries. Ensure accurate application of Best Practices, Financial Practices, Tariffs, and Terms and Conditions to maintain compliance and operational consistency. Complete service agreements and other necessary documents, obtaining customer signatures as required for finalized and validated agreements. Initiate customer accounts with attention to detail and accuracy, prepare invoices, and collect customer payments to ensure accurate account setup and timely payment collection. Issue deposit certificates, accept money from deposits or bill payments, balance daily receipts, deliver funds to the appropriate employee or supervisor, and obtain proof of delivery for secure financial transactions. Process payments via all methods received in regional offices and determine the applicable rate according to the requested service for accurate payment processing. Prepare detailed account statements, invoices, apply deposits, adjust accounts, and process charges and miscellaneous credits manually or through automated systems for precise financial records. Prepare, record, and send documents to necessary inter-departments for Customer Excellence delivery, facilitating efficient interdepartmental communication. Receive reports about irregularities in reading, billing, maintenance, and other related duties, investigate, correct, and process irregularities through the instant information system for timely issue resolution. Follow established company policies, procedures, and standards to ensure full compliance with applicable laws and industry regulations. Participate in storm restoration tasks and assigned drills to contribute to the safe and reliable recovery of services. Perform additional tasks aligned with role expectations and qualifications to support team goals and operational flexibility. Required Experience 1-3 years of relevant experience. Physical Demands Constantly in a stationary position. Seldom required to push, pull, reach, kneel, grab, or bend. Ability to lift/carry up to 0-15 LBS. Requires 20/20 corrected vision. Ability to receive detailed information if spoken to. Working Conditions Never exposed to wet or humid conditions, moving mechanical parts, heavy machinery, high places, fumes, airborne particles, outdoor weather, or electricity. Seldom exposed to loud noise conditions. Equal Employment Opportunity LUMA Energy is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran status, military status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by federal or local laws.

c8a5135c5ae4502f.description: About the Role Awtad is seeking a Purchasing Specialist to manage the company's purchasing activities. This full-time role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and is critical for ensuring the timely availability of materials, equipment, and supplies across various departments. The specialist will coordinate with suppliers, evaluate quotations, negotiate prices, and monitor deliveries to meet company standards and budgets. Role Overview The Purchasing Specialist works closely with technical, operational, warehouse, and finance teams to ensure efficient procurement operations and cost control. The position involves a range of tasks from processing purchase requests to resolving delivery issues, all while maintaining compliance with approved specifications and quality standards. The ideal candidate will have 2-5 years of experience in procurement. Key Responsibilities Receive and review purchase requests, ensuring clear definition of quantities and specifications. Identify potential suppliers and maintain effective relationships with existing ones. Obtain and compare quotations from multiple suppliers based on price, quality, delivery timelines, and payment terms. Negotiate with suppliers to secure competitive prices and favorable commercial terms within authorized limits. Prepare, process, and follow up on purchase orders after obtaining necessary approvals. Monitor supplier deliveries to ensure timely arrival of materials, equipment, and supplies. Coordinate with warehouse and technical teams to verify the quality, quantity, and specifications of delivered items. Review supplier invoices against purchase orders and delivery receipts, coordinating with the Finance Department for payment. Follow up on delayed deliveries, shortages, incorrect items, and discrepancies, coordinating with suppliers for resolution. Prepare periodic procurement reports covering purchasing activities, supplier quotations, pending orders, and delayed deliveries. Maintain accurate procurement records, including quotations, purchase orders, invoices, and related documents. Monitor and evaluate supplier performance based on pricing, quality, delivery timelines, and compliance. Monitor market prices and identify alternative suppliers and cost-saving opportunities. Coordinate with technical, operational, and warehouse departments to ensure timely availability of required materials. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, or a related field (preferred). Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in procurement, purchasing, or supply chain operations. Proven experience in sourcing materials, equipment, and supplies, and managing supplier relationships. Strong knowledge of procurement procedures, purchase orders, quotation evaluation, and supplier negotiations. Ability to compare quotations and evaluate suppliers based on price, quality, and delivery terms. Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, and experience using ERP or procurement systems. Required Skills Strong organizational skills. Excellent communication and negotiation skills. Effective problem-solving abilities. High attention to detail. Ability to manage multiple purchasing requests and meet deadlines. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role requires collaboration with various internal departments including technical, operational, warehouse, and finance teams to ensure seamless procurement processes.

c841da72f77481c2.description: About the Role Datamatics Technologies is seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead end-to-end project delivery in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role requires a professional with 5-10 years of experience in project management, focusing on planning, execution, stakeholder management, resource coordination, and risk management to ensure projects are completed on time, within scope, and within budget. The Project Manager will be responsible for coordinating effectively with both onsite and offshore teams. Key Responsibilities Lead end-to-end project planning, execution, monitoring, and closure. Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, milestones, timelines, and resource requirements. Manage client relationships and maintain effective communication with stakeholders. Coordinate with onsite and offshore teams to ensure smooth project execution and collaboration. Monitor project progress against agreed timelines, budgets, quality standards, and contractual commitments. Establish and maintain project governance, reporting, documentation, and compliance processes. Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks, issues, dependencies, and potential delays. Manage change requests, scope adjustments, escalations, and stakeholder expectations. Allocate resources effectively and ensure team productivity and accountability. Conduct regular project status meetings and provide progress reports to clients and senior management. Ensure deliverables meet agreed quality standards and customer expectations. Drive continuous improvement, operational efficiency, and successful project outcomes. Support client satisfaction, identify opportunities for additional project scope, and contribute to account growth where applicable. Required Qualifications and Experience Must-Have: Proven experience as a Project Manager, IT Project Manager, Program Manager, or in a similar project management role. Strong project planning, execution, monitoring, and delivery management skills. Excellent client-facing and stakeholder management capabilities. Experience managing project scope, timelines, budgets, resources, risks, and dependencies. Strong understanding of project governance, status reporting, and escalation management. Experience coordinating onsite and offshore delivery teams. Excellent leadership, communication, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. Ability to ensure on-time delivery while maintaining project quality standards. Currently working in Saudi Arabia (KSA) and available for an onsite assignment. Available to join immediately or within one month. Good-to-Have: Previous experience delivering projects in Saudi Arabia or the wider Middle East. PMP, PRINCE2, or an equivalent project management certification. Experience in IT consulting, technology services, or client-facing delivery environments. Knowledge of Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, or hybrid project management methodologies. Experience with project management tools such as Jira, Microsoft Project, or Azure DevOps. Experience supporting account growth, identifying new business opportunities, and expanding client engagements. Strong understanding of customer satisfaction (CSAT), operational excellence, and continuous improvement. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field. Performance Indicators On-time and within-budget project delivery. Achievement of agreed project scope, objectives, and milestones. Client satisfaction and stakeholder engagement. Quality and timely completion of project deliverables. Effective resource utilization and team performance. Risk identification, issue resolution, and escalation management. Compliance with project governance and reporting requirements. Successful coordination between onsite and offshore teams. Continuous improvement in delivery efficiency and project outcomes. c8943e4231b87d99.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة أيد المستقبل للتطوير العقاري عن مدير تطوير أعمال للانضمام إلى فريقها في مدينة جدة. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور القيادي مسؤولية تحديد فرص النمو والتوسع الاستراتيجي، وبناء شراكات تجارية فعالة، والمساهمة في زيادة الإيرادات طويلة الأجل للشركة. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 5 و 10 سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع وتطبيق استراتيجيات تطوير الأعمال التي تتماشى مع الأهداف العامة للشركة. استقطاب عملاء جدد وبناء شبكة علاقات قوية مع الشركاء وأصحاب المصلحة. تحليل السوق واكتشاف الفرص والاتجاهات الواعدة ودراسة المنافسين. قيادة عملية التفاوض وإعداد العقود التجارية وعروض الأسعار بشكل احترافي. التعاون والتنسيق المستمر مع فرق المبيعات والتسويق والفرق الداخلية لتحقيق المستهدفات. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 5 و 10 سنوات في مجال تطوير الأعمال أو دور مماثل. سجل مثبت في تحديد فرص النمو وتحقيق الأهداف التجارية. القدرة على بناء وإدارة علاقات قوية مع العملاء والشركاء. فهم عميق لتحليل السوق ودراسة المنافسين. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات قيادية قوية وقدرة على التفكير الاستراتيجي. مهارات تفاوض وإقناع ممتازة. القدرة على إعداد عروض الأسعار والعقود التجارية بدقة واحترافية. مهارات تواصل وتعاون فعالة مع الفرق الداخلية والخارجية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق أيد المستقبل للتطوير العقاري في جدة. يتطلب الدور التنسيق المستمر مع مختلف الأقسام لتحقيق الأهداف المشتركة. تقديم الطلبات الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، ولن يتم الإفصاح عنه في هذه المرحلة. ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة للتقدم لهذه الفرصة.

You will build and improve deployment pipelines, infrastructure-as-code modules, and reusable tooling that makes data services easier to launch, manage, and maintain. Working across data engineering, backend development, and infrastructure, you will contribute to reliable systems that support a global shipping and fulfillment platform. You will join an experienced Data & AI team with established engineering standards, giving you a solid foundation to make a tangible impact from your first weeks. The position offers increasing ownership, with the opportunity to lead the roadmap for shared platform tooling within your first six months. You will also work in an AI-enabled engineering culture that values technical judgment, accountability, and the ability to explain and validate the code you deliver. Accountabilities Improve CI/CD pipelines: Analyze existing deployment pipelines, determine the requirements of new tasks, and adapt established workflows to support reliable, repeatable software delivery. Develop infrastructure-as-code: Extend and maintain infrastructure modules in line with existing repository patterns, ensuring consistency, reliability, and maintainability across services. Apply data governance standards: Implement naming conventions, access controls, retention policies, and other governance requirements for new data services and infrastructure. Build self-service platform tooling: Develop and maintain a reusable template repository with preconfigured CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, and governance standards so engineering teams can launch new pipelines with minimal manual intervention. Create reusable modules: Build tools and modules that simplify pipeline creation and reduce repetitive engineering work, making common platform tasks accessible through standardized workflows. Communication and reasoning: Comfortable explaining technical decisions, defending implementation choices, and being evaluated on reasoning as well as delivery. Learning mindset: Motivated to develop new skills and explore unfamiliar tools. Prior experience with every technology or the specific business domain is not required. c88a3911208a1098.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن شركة صفوة الرياض الخليجية عن حاجتها إلى فني زراعي للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تقديم الدعم الفني والعلمي والمشورة في المجال الزراعي، مع التركيز على تحسين الإنتاجية والجودة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الاختبارات على عينات مثل الخلايا النباتية أو الأنسجة الحيوانية. تحديد تأثيرات طرق الإنتاج المختلفة على نمو المحاصيل وعوائدها. اختبار جودة المنتجات الزراعية. تحديد الطفيليات والكائنات الضارة الأخرى التي قد تؤثر على الإنتاج. تفتيش المزارع وتقييم الظروف البيئية للنباتات والحيوانات، بما في ذلك الرطوبة والحرارة والنظافة. تقديم الدعم الفني والمشورة بشأن تنفيذ إجراءات أو أساليب جديدة لزيادة الإنتاجية والعائد، والمساعدة في تطبيقها. تشغيل وصيانة المعدات البحثية المستخدمة في تحليل العينات وتحديد الكائنات الحية واختبار الجودة. الإشراف على العمال أثناء التنفيذ وتوزيع المهام اليومية عليهم. الإبلاغ عن أي مشاكل قد تطرأ في مواقع العمل. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في المجال الزراعي أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على إجراء الاختبارات والتجارب العلمية. معرفة جيدة بأساليب الإنتاج الزراعي وتأثيراتها. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية ودقة في الملاحظة. القدرة على تشغيل وصيانة المعدات الفنية. مهارات التواصل الفعال لتقديم المشورة والإشراف. الالتزام بمعايير الصحة والسلامة المهنية. بيئة العمل يعمل فني الزراعة ضمن فريق عمل في مواقع المزارع والمختبرات، ويشرف على العمال أثناء تنفيذ المهام اليومية في جدة، مكة المكرمة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل. تقديم الطلبات لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب لهذه الوظيفة. ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم.

c88a506750f1d05a.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة دار مكه للاستشارات الهندسية عن مهندس مدني للانضمام إلى فريقها في الباحة. يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 2 و 5 سنوات، وسيكون المهندس مسؤولاً عن دراسة المواقع الإنشائية، إعداد التصاميم والمخططات، والإشراف على تنفيذ المشاريع لضمان مطابقتها للمواصفات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة طبوغرافية وجيولوجية الموقع الإنشائي وتحليل نتائج اختبار فحص التربة. دراسة المتطلبات والمخططات المعمارية للمشروع بدقة. تحديد أعماق التأسيس اللازمة للمشروع وإجراء تحليل إنشائي متكامل لعناصره. إعداد تصاميم المشروع ومتابعة إعداد المخططات الإنشائية وتدقيقها. تدقيق جداول الكميات والمواصفات للمواد الإنشائية. الإشراف على تنفيذ المشروع ومطابقة المواصفات الفنية والمعايير المعتمدة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال الهندسي. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسبة تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة شهادة جامعية في الهندسة المدنية. خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الهندسة المدنية. فهم عميق لأسس التصميم الإنشائي وتحليل التربة. القدرة على قراءة وتدقيق المخططات الهندسية وجداول الكميات. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات ممتازة في الإشراف على المشاريع ومتابعة التنفيذ. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية والوثائق المتخصصة. مهارات تحليلية قوية ودقة في العمل. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والتواصل الفعال. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الباحة. سيعمل المهندس ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة دار مكه للاستشارات الهندسية، وستتاح له الفرصة للمساهمة في مشاريع إنشائية متنوعة. التقديم ندعو المهندسين المدنيين المؤهلين والمهتمين بهذه الفرصة للتقديم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين الذين تتوافق مؤهلاتهم مع متطلبات الدور.

c8d31943b2e0ad55.description: Company Overview: Baselat Trading Baselat Trading Co. is a Saudi company established in 2003, specializing in automatic vending and refreshment solutions. The company provides coffee service, hot and cold beverages, snacks, and other refreshments to a diverse customer base across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. With over 14 years of industry experience, Baselat Trading Co. focuses on delivering cost-effective solutions that enhance the daily experience for employees and customers, aiming to meet rising demand with tailored offerings. About the Role: Outbound Sales Specialist Baselat Trading is seeking an Outbound Sales Specialist who is a Saudi National to join their team in Riyadh. This is a full-time, on-site position. The specialist will be responsible for engaging with prospective and existing clients to promote the company’s vending and refreshment solutions, identify sales opportunities, and finalize deals. Key Responsibilities Conduct outbound calls and visits to prospective and existing clients. Promote Baselat Trading Co.’s vending and refreshment solutions. Identify sales opportunities and close deals. Generate and qualify leads. Present products and pricing to potential clients. Prepare basic proposals for client solutions. Follow up on inquiries to convert prospects into long-term customers. Maintain regular contact with clients to ensure satisfaction and identify further needs. Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth service delivery. Update sales records and prepare reports on sales activities. Monitor market trends relevant to vending and refreshment solutions. Gather customer feedback to inform service improvements. Contribute to improving sales strategies and enhancing overall customer satisfaction. Work Environment This is an on-site, full-time role based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The specialist will work within a dynamic sales environment, engaging directly with clients and collaborating with internal teams.

c8e8b1a3cef7b8e9.job_title: Senior Project Management Engineer - SAP S/4HANA
c8e8b1a3cef7b8e9.description: Job description . Job Purpose Plan, coordinate, and monitor assigned projects from initiation through completion. Ensure project requirements, schedules, resources, risks, stakeholders, documentation, testing, and deliverables are effectively managed in accordance with approved objectives and timelines. Functional Responsibilities Project Planning & Requirements Develop project plans covering scope, objectives, schedules, milestones, resources, and deliverables. Gather, analyze, and document business and functional requirements in coordination with relevant stakeholders. Define project activities, dependencies, responsibilities, and completion criteria. Ensure project requirements are clearly communicated and agreed upon before execution. Project Execution & Coordination Coordinate project activities across internal departments, business units, and external service providers. Monitor the execution of project plans and ensure activities are completed according to approved schedules. Facilitate project meetings and follow up on agreed actions, decisions, and outstanding requirements. Support the resolution of execution issues and coordination gaps affecting project delivery. Ensure effective communication between project stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle. Progress Monitoring & Risk Management Monitor project progress against approved plans, milestones, and deliverables. Identify project risks, delays, dependencies, and resource constraints. Develop and follow up on mitigation and recovery actions. Evaluate the impact of changes and issues on project scope, schedule, and deliverables. Escalate significant risks and delays to the relevant management when required. Testing, Implementation & Handover Coordinate testing and validation activities to ensure delivered solutions meet approved requirements. Follow up on identified issues and ensure corrective actions are completed before implementation. Coordinate implementation and project handover activities with relevant stakeholders. Ensure required approvals, documentation, and acceptance criteria are completed before project closure. Support post-implementation follow-up and closure of outstanding issues. Project Documentation & Reporting Prepare and maintain project plans, schedules, meeting records, action logs, risk registers, and status reports. Maintain accurate records of project requirements, changes, decisions, approvals, and deliverables. Prepare regular project progress reports highlighting achievements, risks, delays, and required actions. Ensure project documentation is complete, organized, and updated throughout the project lifecycle. Process Improvement Review project outcomes and document lessons learned. Identify opportunities to improve project planning, coordination, execution, and reporting practices. Support the implementation of approved project management process improvements. General Responsibilities HR Proficiency: Ability to obtain updated soft and technical skills related to the job Delivery: Perform the planned activities to meet the operational and development targets as per delivery schedules. Utilize resources effectively to achieve objectives within efficient cost and time. Provide a periodic report formatted by detailing the deviation and execution of planned tasks. Problem-Solving: Solve any related problems arise and escalate any complex operational issues. Quality: Ensure quality requirements to develop effective quality control and processes including specifications for products or processes or related activities. Business Process Improvements: Coordinate well-defined written systems, policies, procedures, and seek automations opportunities as much as possible. Compliance: Comply to related policy and procedures and work instructions. Health, Safety, and Environment: Ensure compliance of relevant safety, quality, and environmental management procedures and controls within defined area of work activity to guarantee safety, legislative compliance, and delivery of high-quality products/services. Qualification Bachelor in Computer Engineering or Any relevant field Experience 6 to 10 Years Skills Ad Hoc Reporting Details Oriented Well Organized Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

This full-time role involves providing essential preventive and corrective maintenance, alongside day-to-day technical support for IT assets and end-users. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Perform preventive maintenance for IT devices and technical assets. Receive and respond to emergency technical support and maintenance requests. Analyze support requests and provide appropriate technical solutions. Troubleshoot and maintain IT equipment based on registered support tickets. Document resolutions and close requests within the technical support system. c842491154980551.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مصنع براك بن ناصر بن مسعود الدوسري للاسفلت عن مشرف صحة وسلامة مهنية للانضمام إلى فريقه في الهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى ضمان تطبيق معايير السلامة والصحة المهنية ومتابعة الالتزام باللوائح التنظيمية في المنشآت. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية متابعة تطبيق القوانين واللوائح التنظيمية والتعليمات المتعلقة بالسلامة والصحة المهنية في المنشآت. إجراء عمليات التفتيش الدورية والطارئة في مواقع العمل وتسجيل النتائج ومقارنتها بالمعايير المعتمدة. تجهيز معدات وأجهزة قياس العوامل البيئية مثل درجة الحرارة والرطوبة والضجيج والاهتزاز، وتوثيق النتائج ومتابعة معالجة الأخطار. تحضير مستلزمات التحقيق في الحوادث والإصابات، وإجراء التحقيق وتوثيق النتائج بشكل دقيق. إعداد تعليمات وإجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية، وتعليمات العمل الآمن والإخلاء، وتوعية العاملين بها. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية وتوثيقها وحفظها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الصحة والسلامة المهنية. القدرة على تطبيق القوانين واللوائح التنظيمية المتعلقة بالسلامة والصحة المهنية. مهارات في قياس العوامل البيئية والتحقيق في الحوادث والإصابات. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات ممتازة في إعداد التقارير والتوثيق. القدرة على إعداد وتطبيق تعليمات وإجراءات السلامة. مهارات التواصل والتوعية الفعالة للعاملين. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الفرصة بدوام كامل في الهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية، ضمن بيئة عمل تلتزم بأعلى معايير السلامة المهنية. تقديم الطلبات للمهتمين، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم للانضمام إلى فريق عمل مصنع براك بن ناصر بن مسعود الدوسري للاسفلت. سيتم تحديد الراتب بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

c8d8508cddfa7674.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المحطه للمقاولات عن مشرف موقع إنشائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور إلى ضمان تطبيق القواعد واللوائح الخاصة بالإنشاءات في المواقع، والمساهمة في سير العمليات بفعالية وأمان. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. الهدف من الوظيفة يتمثل الهدف الرئيسي لمشرف الموقع الإنشائي في الإشراف المباشر على المواقع الإنشائية لضمان الامتثال التام للمعايير واللوائح المحددة. يشمل ذلك مراقبة العمليات وتحديد أي مخالفات محتملة، بالإضافة إلى متابعة تنفيذ الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة لضمان الجودة والسلامة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مراقبة مدى التزام مواقع الإنشاءات بالقواعد واللوائح المعمول بها، والإبلاغ عن أي مخالفات مع تحديد الإجراءات التصحيحية المطلوبة. متابعة تنفيذ الإجراءات التصحيحية في المواقع الإنشائية لضمان معالجة المشكلات بفعالية. مراجعة المخططات الأولية والخطط الخاصة بمشاريع الإنشاءات وإصدار التراخيص اللازمة للمضي قدماً في الأعمال عند التأكد من الالتزام بالمعايير. فحص النظم والمعدات مثل أجهزة الرفع والنقل والممرات الجانبية المتحركة، والتأكد من مطابقتها للمواصفات المطلوبة. تطبيق إجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية في جميع مراحل العمل بالموقع. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال الإشراف على المواقع الإنشائية أو مجال ذي صلة. فهم جيد للقواعد واللوائح الخاصة بالإنشاءات. بيئة العمل يعمل مشرف الموقع الإنشائي بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض، ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية تتطلب التواجد الميداني في مواقع الإنشاءات. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى شركة المحطه للمقاولات، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة تفاصيل الدور.

c89c5b9dc9b7fefa.description: Job Description What if you could do the kind of work the world needs? At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you. We are seeking a Roads & Wet Utilities Engineer to join our Supervision team in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. The successful candidate will be responsible for overseeing the construction and delivery of roadworks and wet utilities infrastructure, ensuring compliance with project specifications, authority requirements, quality standards, and health and safety regulations. The role requires strong technical knowledge, site supervision expertise, and previous consultancy experience on infrastructure projects within Jeddah or the Western Region of Saudi Arabia. Responsibilities Monitor and supervise the construction of roads, stormwater drainage, potable water, wastewater, and irrigation networks. Review contractor submissions, shop drawings, material approvals, method statements, and work inspections. Ensure all works are executed in accordance with approved drawings, project specifications, contract requirements, and local authority regulations. Conduct regular site inspections and identify construction issues, providing timely technical solutions and recommendations. Coordinate with contractors, clients, utility authorities, and multidisciplinary supervision teams to ensure smooth project delivery. Verify work progress and assist in the review of contractor payment applications and variation claims. Monitor construction quality and ensure compliance with approved quality assurance and quality control procedures. Support the Resident Engineer in resolving technical and contractual matters related to roads and wet utilities works. Review as-built drawings and support project close-out activities. Ensure adherence to health, safety, and environmental requirements throughout the construction phase. Qualifications Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering. 8-12 years of experience in roads and wet utilities projects, with the majority gained in a consultancy or engineering supervision environment. Previous experience supervising infrastructure projects in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia is essential. Strong knowledge of roadworks, water distribution networks, wastewater systems, stormwater drainage, and irrigation infrastructure. Familiarity with Saudi codes, standards, and authority requirements, including those applicable within Jeddah. Experience reviewing contractor submissions and coordinating with multiple stakeholders during construction. Strong communication, coordination, and report-writing skills. Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all. Join our close-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world. With us, you can. Apply today.

c89f4839c63ace77.description: About AECOM AECOM is a global infrastructure consulting firm that partners with clients to address complex challenges and build legacies for future generations. The company's work supports communities by improving commutes, ensuring power supply, providing access to clean water, and transforming skylines. With over 50,000 professionals worldwide, AECOM delivers projects that have a positive and tangible impact globally. Role Overview AECOM is seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Lead Field Engineer - Structural to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves overseeing structural engineering operations on-site, ensuring all construction activities adhere to design specifications, quality standards, and safety requirements. The Lead Field Engineer will manage a team of engineers and technicians, maintaining direct communication with project management, architects, and contractors. The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical capabilities, decisive leadership, and a commitment to excellence in structural engineering execution. Key Responsibilities Supervise and coordinate all structural engineering activities on construction sites, ensuring compliance with approved plans, specifications, and the Saudi Building Code. Conduct daily site inspections and quality control checks to verify structural integrity, material specifications, and workmanship standards. Analyze structural performance data and field conditions, providing technical recommendations and solutions for design or construction challenges. Lead and mentor a team of field engineers and technicians, delegating tasks, monitoring performance, and fostering professional development. Prepare and maintain comprehensive field reports, inspection logs, and documentation for project records and regulatory compliance. Collaborate with project managers, architects, and contractors to ensure seamless coordination and timely resolution of structural issues. Implement and enforce safety protocols and best practices to maintain a secure work environment for all personnel. Review and interpret structural drawings, specifications, and technical documents to ensure accurate field implementation. Manage material testing, inspections, and certifications in accordance with project requirements and industry standards. Communicate technical findings and recommendations to stakeholders through clear written and verbal reports. Participate in project meetings and provide expert input on structural matters, timelines, and resource allocation. Required Qualifications Minimum of 15 years of professional experience in structural engineering field operations and site supervision. Proficiency with structural analysis and design software including SAP2000, ETABS, and AutoCAD. Comprehensive knowledge of building codes and standards (IBC, ACI, AISC, and Saudi Building Code). Demonstrated experience in project management and construction site supervision. Strong expertise in quality control procedures, material testing, and safety protocols. Proven leadership and team management capabilities with experience supervising engineering personnel. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Ability to read, interpret, and analyze structural drawings and technical specifications. Organized and detail-oriented approach to work with strong analytical capabilities. Professional demeanor and commitment to maintaining high standards of conduct. Preferred Qualifications Previous experience working on construction projects in the Middle East region. Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent credential. Experience with Building Information Modeling (BIM) software and processes. Background in large-scale commercial, industrial, or infrastructure projects. Knowledge of international construction standards and practices. Experience mentoring and training junior engineers and field staff. Familiarity with construction management software and digital documentation systems. Additional Information AECOM is committed to a secure recruitment process. All newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment. AECOM offers comprehensive benefits designed to meet the diverse needs of its employees. AECOM is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

c8de16aa2f37cb2a.description: About the Role Alesayi Holding is seeking an Estate Coordinator to manage a portfolio of labor accommodation buildings in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves overseeing day-to-day operations, ensuring compliance, and maintaining living standards for residents. The ideal candidate will have 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Monitor outsourced accommodation providers to ensure compliance with contract terms, service levels, and billing, including invoice validation and deviation escalation. Conduct regular inspections of accommodation buildings, assessing cleanliness, hygiene, maintenance conditions, and living standards, with documented findings and follow-up. Ensure resident well-being and safety, including fire-safety and regulatory compliance, serving as the primary contact for resident complaints and resolving issues within agreed timelines. Log, prioritize, and follow up on maintenance requests with providers or in-house technicians, tracking recurring faults and cost per building. Maintain comprehensive accommodation records, including occupancy, licenses, permits, and inspection reports, for audit and government inspection readiness. Produce a monthly estate scorecard detailing occupancy, cost per head, service-level performance, open complaints, and safety findings. Qualifications and Experience Diploma or bachelor's degree in facility management, business administration, or a related field. 3+ years of experience in facility, property, or workforce accommodation management. Experience managing outsourced service providers against Service Level Agreements (SLAs) is an advantage. Required Skills Working knowledge of accommodation, fire-safety, and municipal/civil-defense requirements. Strong inspection, reporting, and follow-up discipline. Proficiency with Excel and facility-management or ticketing systems. Clear communication skills for multicultural resident populations, with a firm but fair approach to handling complaints and supplier escalations. Organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple sites with regular travel within the region. Additional Requirements A valid driving license is required for this role. Proven experience working in a site-based construction supervision environment, verifying contractor setting out and as built data. Ability to read and interpret engineering, architectural, and utility drawings and translate them into precise field layouts. Strong attention to detail, analytical skills, and record-keeping, with a commitment to accuracy and quality. Good communication and coordination skills, able to work effectively with multi-disciplinary teams and contractors. Experience in KSA or the GCC region is preferred.

The approach you'd be leading: We call it 3/3/3 3 days: Product concept. Everyone aligned on scope, objectives and how we'll measure success. 3 weeks: Working prototype. Desirability, viability and feasibility tested with real users. 3 months: MLP launch. A production-grade minimum lovable product, ready to keep evolving. Think of it as a reference tempo rather than a fixed schedule. The sequence is what we believe in: align quickly, get real evidence early, put something usable in front of customers while the idea is still current. A regulated platform with a heavy integration surface won't run like a greenfield mobile app, and reading the difference is part of the job. AI runs through all of it, and not as a feature we add at the end. We use AI across the whole lifecycle, from specification and design through build, test and operations, and you'd be one of the people defining what good looks like there. Who You'd Work With We work in tight forward-deployed pods: one Product Strategist, one Experience Designer, and two Forward-Deployed Engineers. You're one of the FDEs — the lead engineer on the pod — guiding architecture, delivery cadence, and technical commercial choices, while collaborating with the strategist and designer as equal partners rather than a downstream requirements queue. Some of the best moments in this job happen when team members explore a challenge from complementary perspectives and unlock innovative solutions. On larger programmes you'll lead across multiple pods, each running its own 3/3/3 rhythm — sometimes a mix of Product Innovation, Modernization/Engineering and Data & AI pod types depending on the engagement shape. You'd report to Ahmet Sakar, Director of Technology for CXPD, and operate as part of a small Tech Principal cadre collaborating directly as peers. Lighthouse projects come in all sizes. Sometimes it's one pod and a single product bet. Sometimes it's a multi-year programme with several streams running at once, real platform and modernization work underneath, and a steering committee to keep alongside. Either way, the work is visible, and when it lands it becomes the case study, the reference architecture and the talk you get invited to give. How Autonomous You Are This is a Tech Principal role, not a Tech Lead. Within Thoughtworks' Radar and CXPD's delivery standards, you make the calls: architecture patterns, stack selection, pod composition for your engagements, commercial pricing tolerances within the band, and the technical position in a pitch. Ahmet is the escalation point for the largest bets, cross-region consistency questions, and firm-wide precedent — everything else lands with you. This isn't a role where every decision gets a second look before it lands with the client. Working in KSA This role anchors in Riyadh, working across the Kingdom's most ambitious digital bets — Vision 2030-aligned government transformation, PIF-family portfolio companies, financial services, energy, retail and public sector. Expect regulated-industry delivery, data-residency requirements under PDPL, and a client base where Arabic-language proficiency is an asset, though not a strict requirement. Job responsibilities Shaping the bet. Running concept sprints with client executives, product managers and designers. Turning a broad ambition into something scoped and testable. Agreeing what success looks like, and what would tell us to stop, before anyone writes code. Winning the work. Partnering with account leads to shape technical narratives on new pursuits. Supporting the pod construct and 3/3/3 commercial arc with client leaders with a clear understanding of pricing parameters. Owning technical scope in proposals, presenting confidently, and maintaining focus when discovery reveals core project requirements. Proving it. Setting the technical direction for prototyping: what to build, what to fake, what to buy, and what evidence each prototype needs to produce. Pairing with designers and engineers so prototypes can actually be tested with users. Standing up proper evaluation for anything AI-powered, including golden datasets, offline evals, human review, guardrails, and cost and latency budgets. Landing it. Owning an architecture that ships in three months and stands up long-term. Establishing delivery systems around it: agentic workflows with human oversight, continuous delivery, test strategy, observability, security, and privacy by design. On larger initiatives, maintaining architectural alignment across streams so each can ship independently. Advising. Serving as a trusted technology advisor to key stakeholders. Aligning technical options with business outcomes. Presenting to steering committees, facilitating executive workshops, and shaping new opportunities with client partners. Developing team members. Pairing, reviewing code, and mentoring colleagues. Creating reusable practices to support team continuity. Mentoring engineers onto lighthouse projects and sharing knowledge broadly across internal and external communities. Job Qualifications Technical Skills Programming languages: Strong proficiency in Python or TypeScript, with working knowledge of the other, alongside experience shipping production code in at least one additional language. AI & LLM ecosystems: Hands-on experience with major LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, Vertex), RAG and vector databases (pgvector, Pinecone, Elastic), and agent frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex). c86b0adefc918265.description: نظرة عامة على الوظيفة تبحث شركة البابطين لصناعة البسكويت والمواد الغذائيه عن مشرف صحة وسلامة مهنية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية متابعة تطبيق لوائح السلامة والصحة المهنية، وإجراء التحقيقات في الحوادث، وتقديم التقارير اللازمة لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية متابعة تطبيق القوانين واللوائح التنظيمية والتعليمات المتعلقة بالسلامة والصحة المهنية في المنشآت. إجراء عمليات التفتيش الدورية والطارئة في مواقع العمل وتسجيل نتائجها ومقارنتها بالمعايير المعتمدة. تجهيز معدات وأجهزة قياس العوامل البيئية مثل درجة الحرارة والرطوبة والضجيج والاهتزاز، وتوثيق النتائج ومتابعة معالجة الأخطار. تحضير مستلزمات التحقيق في الحوادث والإصابات، وإجراء التحقيقات اللازمة، وتوثيق النتائج. إعداد تعليمات وإجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية، وتعليمات العمل الآمن والإخلاء، وتوعية العاملين بها. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال الصحة والسلامة المهنية. القدرة على متابعة وتطبيق القوانين واللوائح التنظيمية المتعلقة بالسلامة. مهارات جيدة في إعداد التقارير والتوثيق. نوع الوظيفة والموقع هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتقع في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. عن شركة البابطين لصناعة البسكويت والمواد الغذائيه تعد شركة البابطين لصناعة البسكويت والمواد الغذائيه من الشركات الرائدة في مجالها، وتلتزم بتوفير بيئة عمل آمنة وصحية لجميع موظفيها. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة الوظيفية.

c883361ba57be024.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن شركة كرم الوطن عن حاجتها لفني كهربائي تمديدات كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في عنيزة، القصيم. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال التمديدات الكهربائية، ويهدف إلى ضمان تنفيذ وصيانة الأنظمة الكهربائية بكفاءة وأمان. المهام الرئيسية دراسة مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية المنزلية والصناعية والتجارية ومكوناتها بدقة. تقدير كميات المواد والأجهزة اللازمة لتنفيذ أعمال التمديدات وتأمين التجهيزات المطابقة للمواصفات. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال التمديدات الكهربائية وتشغيل دارات التمديدات وفحصها، بما في ذلك فحوص العازلية والاستمرارية والتأريض. تشخيص أعطال التمديدات الكهربائية وتحديد الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة لمعالجتها. متابعة أعمال الصيانة الوقائية لضمان استمرارية وكفاءة التمديدات الكهربائية. تطبيق إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية في جميع مراحل العمل. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات كفني تمديدات كهربائية. القدرة على قراءة وفهم المخططات الكهربائية المختلفة. معرفة قوية بمعايير السلامة الكهربائية وإجراءات الصحة المهنية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تشخيص الأعطال الكهربائية وتحديد حلولها. القدرة على تقدير المواد والأجهزة بدقة. الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والسلامة في العمل. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة عنيزة بمنطقة القصيم، وتتطلب العمل ضمن فريق متخصص في تنفيذ وصيانة التمديدات الكهربائية لمشاريع متنوعة. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة الشخصية. نشجع المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة على التقديم لهذه الفرصة.

c8a994e3886d09f1.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة إعمار الخليج للاستشارات الهندسية عن فني هندسة كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تركيب وصيانة الأنظمة الكهربائية، وتقديم الدعم الفني للمهندسين. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تركيب المحركات واللوحات والمولدات والمحولات الكهربائية، والإشراف عليها ومراقبتها. تحديد المخططات، وتقدير كمية المواد والمعدات واليد العاملة المطلوبة بناءً على المخططات الأولية. توجيه وتنسيق جهود العمال والفنيين والحرفيين الآخرين المتعلقة بأعمال التركيب الكهربائي. اختبار الأنظمة بعد تركيبها لضمان التقيد بالمخطط الأولي والمواصفات المطلوبة. إجراء عمليات الفحص الروتينية ضمن الصيانة الوقائية، وتشخيص الأعطال والتلف المحتمل، واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية. التحقق من الأعطال وفحص الأجزاء والمعدات المعطوبة، وتشخيص المكونات التالفة وإصلاحها أو استبدالها. ضمان الاستجابة السريعة لعمليات الطوارئ للتقليل من فترات انقطاع التيار الكهربائي. تقديم المساعدة للمهندسين الكهربائيين في حل المشكلات الفنية. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية أو ما يعادلها. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات والمواصفات الفنية. مهارات جيدة في تشخيص الأعطال وإصلاحها. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في الهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية. سيعمل الفني ضمن فريق متخصص، ويدعم المهندسين في تنفيذ المشاريع الكهربائية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، ولن يتم الإفصاح عنه في هذه المرحلة. التقديم للمهتمين بالتقديم على وظيفة فني هندسة كهربائية، يرجى إرسال السيرة الذاتية.

c8c034253f5ac1df.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة وجد الحياة للتجارة عن مهندس أجهزة طبية للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إدارة دورة حياة الأجهزة الطبية، بدءًا من
